scope: Only new actual-facade test and report/log evidence. No product edits, real-user login/logout, GUI interaction, data reset or real chat-body inspection.
coverage: Quote 114 uses official sendMessageNotOss, preserves request and operation ID, retains semantic quote preview, and receives actual recursive legacy adaptation.
Text and ordinary media content types 101/102/103/104/105/106/107/108/110 retain normal SDK send/upload routing.
Group Quote response receives real compatibility defaults and enterprise group-read hydration with asserted parameters and read counts.
Meeting customType 905 authorizes before normal SDK send; denied authorization reaches neither SDK send method.
Malformed Quote fails before either Go sender.

initialAssertionCorrection.reason: Real legacy adaptation intentionally adds empty-string fields to the quoted nested message. Deep equality against the unadapted fixture was incorrect. Assertions now compare semantic preview fields and immutable request serialization. No product change was made for this correction.

evidenceChain.actualUserLog: Real log records nil pointer panic at conversation_msg/api.go:509 and subsequent fixed WASM-exited rejections. It does not explicitly record the triggering outbound contentType114. No real message body was exported.
evidenceChain.sourceInference: Pinned core api.go:509 lies only in the Quote branch and dereferences a lookup result without a nil guard. Missing referenced message in a new target conversation was initially a source-based hypothesis.
evidenceChain.syntheticConfirmation: Root reproduced the same Go panic/exited state using normal Windows Electron, original386 source, original multi-recipient selector and synthetic quote forwarding. With the safe route five recipients received one preserved quote each and subsequent self/history calls remained usable.

limits: These six tests exercise the actual facade with controlled external boundaries; native live SDK evidence comes from the separately referenced root reports.
Native runs use Vite source with normal Electron and do not prove final NSIS package acceptance.
Only Quote is routed through NotOss; ordinary media upload paths remain normal.

publicTextCredentialScan.scope: Only the 10 named source/test/evidence UTF-8 files; no full-project, binary, image or OCR scan claim.
